correctness.rationale: Two-color equations yield s=1+1/[4(4D-1)] and (u-v)^2=s(3/2-s), with nontrivial population-state branch exactly D>3/8. Degree-normalized P is similar to symmetric bipartite S. The complete Jacobian reduces to 2x2 singular-pair blocks with q=sigma²∈[0,1], plus possible q=0 unpaired eigenvalues. The three strict Schur inequalities are affine in q and hence follow from q=0,1. The q=1 endpoint yields exact open interval ((4+sqrt6)/16,(19+sqrt73)/64); q=0 is uniformly strictly stable there. Independent fixed-point and full-Jacobian eigenvalue checks on path, star, cycle and K2 at four D values confirmed sink classification and residuals <=2.3e-16. No boundary nonlinear stability claim.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The inspected Resultary result is a temporally period-two pinned branch on regular bipartite graphs with varying logistic multiplier. It does not establish stationary two-value sinks at multiplier four on arbitrary connected nonregular bipartite graphs.
